summary: A dropdown menu opened by a three-dot icon button, with Share and Copy link items aligned to the end.
use: Compact overflow menus on cards and table rows where a full button would take too much space.
spec: `{#snippet triggerChild(props)}` renders `<IconButton aria-label="More options" {...props}>` with `<MoreHorizontal size={18} />`
`<DropdownMenuLabel>Actions</DropdownMenuLabel>` then 2 items: Share and Copy link
Item content is passed with `{#snippet children()}` using `<Share2 size={14} />` and `<Copy size={14} />`
